sloka: अथ अंगद वचः श्रुत्वा तेन एव च समागतौ ।मंत्रिणो वानरेन्द्रस्य सम्मत उदार दर्शिनौ ॥४-३१-४२॥
transliteration: atha aṁgada vacaḥ śrutvā tena eva ca samāgatau ।maṁtriṇo vānarendrasya sammata udāra darśinau ॥4-31-42॥

translations.english: On hearing Angada's words the two ministers named Plaksha and Prabhava who were perrmitted to have audience with the queens went to the harem on invitation from Angada. They reported to Sugriva about the arrival of Lakshmana who had come to speak to him about matters regading wealth and righteousness.
translations.hindi: उस समय उन दानरों का एक साथ किलकारियों. का शब्द ऐसा हुआ जैसा कि, बिजली की कड़क का अथवा सिंहनाद का होता है । यह शब्द लक्ष्मण जी के पास ही हुआ था
